in_marathi.name: Parnika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parnika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Parnika is the name of the divine lotus flower which holds Lord Vishnu's form, Garuda, in its many petals. It represents purity, creation, and is the embodiment of grace.

in_bengali.name: Parnika
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lotus seed
